max_depth truncates content beyond the specified depth

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<div><p>Shallow</p><div><div><div><p>Too deep</p></div></div></div></div>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(max_depth: 3))
puts result.content.inspect
```
